issue: RAM leak: wait_signal closures keep the whole level store alive in the global hump.signal registry when the player exits or restarts a level before the signal fires; plus weak per-frame GC step.

changes.change: wait_signal: track each registered handler on store._wait_signal_handlers; clear the tracking entry on normal deregistration
game:destroy(): remove all still-registered wait_signal handlers from the signal registry via signal.remove, then clear the table
love.run: use collectgarbage("step", 512) when heap exceeds 400 MB instead of a single step

install: Copy CAP_NHAT contents over the game root (folder containing main.lua and all/).
rollback: Copy BACKUP contents over the game root.
note: Files use TAB indentation and are byte-faithful to base_commit. Verify with KIEM_TRA_LUA.txt after any manual edit.
